title: DLMF 4.21 Identities: In ( 4.21.21 )–( 4.21.23 ) Table 4.16.1 and analytic continuation will assist in resolving sign ambiguities.
summary: DLMF 4.21 Identities: In ( 4.21.21 )–( 4.21.23 ) Table 4.16.1 and analytic continuation will assist in resolving sign ambiguities.
body: NIST DLMF section 4.21 (Identities) says: "In ( 4.21.21 )–( 4.21.23 ) Table 4.16.1 and analytic continuation will assist in resolving sign ambiguities. This result is also valid when n is fractional or complex, provided that -\pi\leq\Re z\leq\pi . If t=\tan\left(\frac{1}{2}z\right) , then" Equation 4.21.1 on the page has alt text "\sin u\pm\cos u=\sqrt{2}\sin\left(u\pm\tfrac{1}{4}\pi\right)=\pm\sqrt{2}\cos% \left(u\mp\tfrac{1}{4}\pi\right).". Equation 4.21.12 on the page has alt text "{\sin}^{2}z+{\cos}^{2}z=1,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
